claims.claim: The proposal requests 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve for a part-time Pallas maintainer over 12 months at an annual rate of $105,000 USD.
The total requested treasury withdrawal is 540,750 ADA, consisting of 525,000 ADA for Pallas maintenance and enhancement and 15,750 ADA for the Intersect Budget Administration fee.

Pallas is a collection of Rust crates that re-implement core Ouroboros and Cardano primitives including CBOR encoding, cryptographic operations, mini-protocol networking, multi-era ledger traversal, transaction building, and address handling.
Pallas is used as shared infrastructure by projects including Aiken, Dolos, Lucid, Oura, Mithril, Amaru, UTxO-RPC and others.
The proposal states Pallas has over 649 pull requests, 199 stars, 91 forks, 60 contributors, and 214,446 downloads on crates.io, with GitHub and crates.io links provided for verification.
The maintainer scope includes essential maintenance, community support, and AI-friendly documentation and integration resources.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain Treasury Withdrawal submission.
The requested amount does not at submission, alone or in aggregate, breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals across Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 currently under development and on schedule.

Intersect will manage funds through Treasury Reserve and Project-Specific Smart Contracts with specified admin, leadership, and external oversight sign-off requirements, and a public dashboard for auditing.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA for a second year of Pallas maintenance, describes Pallas as core open-source Rust infrastructure for Cardano projects, provides budget and scope details, cites Intersect process approval and NCL compliance, and describes smart-contract-based custody and oversight arrangements.
